faq_heading: 1 bedroom condos in Cloverdale: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a 1 bedroom condo cost in Cloverdale?
faq.a: Of the 1 bedroom condos in Cloverdale, 50 sold over the past year at a median of $399,450, with the middle half between $389,175 and $415,000.

faq.q: How long does a 1 bedroom condo take to sell in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The median was 35 days, and homes sold for 97.4% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which Cloverdale neighbourhood has the most 1 bedroom condos sales?
faq.a: Clayton, with 31 of the 50 sales at a median of $404,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in Cloverdale have 1 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Waterstone (9 sales, median $418,000); 72 CrossRoads (3 sales); The Ridge at Bose Farms (3 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 1 bedroom condo in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 1 bedroom condos that sold in Cloverdale was $347 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 1 bedroom condos in Cloverdale compare
A 1 bedroom condo in Cloverdale sold for $125,550 less at the median than a 2 bedroom one ($399,450 against $525,000, 75 sales). The strata fee was $347 a month against $463.
